descriptionByLocale.it:
In Short The world’s fastest-growing sports brand is seeking a passionate, hands-on Treasury expert to drive our global finance team forward. Working closely with colleagues across the globe, you will be a core part of On's Treasury function, helping to lead strategic projects and implementing new processes to support our global expansion. Reporting to the Head of Group Treasury, this is a pivotal role where you will own and drive innovation across our Treasury function. You are the go-to data expert, leveraging exceptional analytical and corporate finance modeling skills to go beyond the numbers, uncover the 'why', and transform complex data into clear, actionable insights. You will be the true product owner of our entire treasury technology stack (including Kyriba, Palm, Looker and Looker Studio, Big Query), championing innovation by embedding AI and automation into our daily operations. You will proactively challenge the wider team to redefine what is possible in the future of treasury, and play a crucial role in our journey to build a low-maintenance, high-value Treasury team. Your Mission
• You go beyond the numbers to uncover the 'why,' challenging assumptions and building strong relationships across the business to masterfully craft and communicate the compelling financial stories that guide our path.
• You architect and build our treasury-focused data lake, creating a single source of truth. You use this platform to design and maintain live, interactive dashboards that deliver real-time, actionable insights to Treasury and management.
• You act as the ultimate sparring partner for the Treasury Core function, challenging their models and assumptions, providing data-driven action plans to drastically improve forecasting accuracy, and actively helping define key KPIs for strategic cash, FX, and financing steering.
• You use your strong financial acumen to support high-impact corporate financial modeling requests, analyzing statements and creating sophisticated models that propel strategic decisions across the company.
• You champion innovation by relentlessly embedding AI and automation into our treasury operations, using data-driven insights to inspire and challenge the wider team to embrace new, low-maintenance, high-value technologies.
• You own and continuously enhance our core treasury technology stack (including Kyriba, Palm, Looker and Looker Studio, Big Query, and FXall), proactively identifying, driving, and implementing improvements necessary to accelerate our global growth. Your Story
• You are driven by a deep passion for data analytics and possess a natural talent for turning complex information into clear, actionable insights.
• We value your potential, analytical drive, and strong financial acumen most. While relevant professional experience from a role in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or a general Finance function is a bonus, your ability to perform ad hoc financial modeling, read and analyze financial statements, and assist with corporate finance models is key.
• You possess a solid knowledge of AI with a clear understanding of how to apply it to drive business value. You are an automation enthusiast who proactively builds workflows to eliminate manual tasks and streamline operations.
• You have a bias toward action and the attitude to try things out, iterate quickly, and find the best path forward.
• You bring an insatiable curiosity and a "tinker" mindset, with the initiative to experiment with new tools and learn through doing.
• You act as a true business partner, collaborating effectively across the organization—from IT and data specialists to accounting, controlling, and management.
• You’re fluent in English and can adapt your communication style to different audiences, both in terms of seniority and affinity to numbers. Your Team Join the forward-thinking, action-oriented Finance team—the speedboat's backbone and advanced navigator. We are committed to challenging the status quo, driving growth, and shaping tomorrow’s best practices through cross-functional action and leveraging the latest technology. To deliver controlled and sustainable growth, we require an entrepreneurial, results-driven mindset, strong analytical capabilities, and hands-on execution skills. ​​What we offer On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose. On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Social media is central to the On brand and key to connecting with our communities in a genuine way to communicate our brand mission ‘to ignite the human spirit through movement’. Running is at our core and as we continue to grow we’re looking for an experienced social media creative to bring to life our Running campaigns and athletes stories across Instagram, TikTok, Strava and YouTube. You’ll collaborate with global marketing, strategy, creative, digital and art direction teams to land our key campaigns with our running communities. Reporting to the Lead - Global Social Media , you’ll be key to creating compelling stories for our social channels. Your mission:
• Oversee all social media planning from conception to execution for our running campaigns, projects and events.
• Engage with our target communities through insight-led social content creation: with an ambition to disrupt run culture and deepen the connection to our athletes
• Develop and present brilliant ideas aimed at impacting running culture through social media to internal stakeholders
• Brief internal and external creative teams on socially-native content designed to entertain and be shared whilst maintaining a premium edge
• Comfortable capturing or directing content on campaign sets, as well as during live sporting eventsCollaborate closely with our internal athlete strategy team to concept and create insight-led stories with our world-class portfolio of athletes
• Demonstrate the ability to challenge conventions and the status quo, constantly seeking new ideas, methods, and technologies to improve social output Your story:
• 5+ years’ working in a social media content creation role
• You may have experience working as a social media manager or social creative / social art director
• Passionate about running. You have a deep understanding of what running means to different people of varying abilities, from your everyday runners to elite runners, and everything in between
• Comfortable working autonomously with the ability to communicate efficiently with stakeholders of varying seniority
• Ability to implement and work towards self-imposed deadlines and timings that align with wider teams
• Live and breathe social media, staying on top of the latest content formats and trends is a must
• Proven track record of developing ideas and content strategies to deliver views and engagement across key channels like TikTok, Instagram, Strava and YouTube
• Be proactive and collaborative, with experience working in a high-performing team
• Brief and manage external creative partners (photographers, content creators, agencies)
• Strong communication and writing skills - presenting ideas and plans to marketing, strategy, communication, production and creative teams
• You have the desire to produce best-in-class content and experience in producing or commissioning content yourself

descriptionByLocale.it:
In short: We are looking for an experienced internal comms expert, skilled at telling stories through innovative mediums as we drive the next chapter of strategic communication at On. Reporting to the Global Head of Internal Communications, the Head of Internal Content & Channels will lead the editorial strategy to reach our internal audience. This hands-on role will drive production of creative content across company-wide events, announcements, presentations, and other strategic moments. They will also lead complex innovation workstreams to build and improve the channels we use to communicate. This role will be highly embedded in On’s unique and entrepreneurial culture; collaborating with multiple teams and leaders to optimize information flow and bring great messages to life. Your mission:
• Leading the creative arm of the Internal Comms team – including concept development, editorial planning, narrative, and production.
• Partnering closely with internal creative teams and external vendors to produce premium video and multimedia content.
• Writing messages, speeches, and presentations for global audiences on key topics related to our strategy and culture.
• Driving innovation strategy for company-wide channels; scoping new formats and driving them forward from proposal to adoption. Your story: In addition to a specific passion for internal communication and culture, we hope you’ll also bring:
• 10+ years of experience working in creative and multi-disciplinary roles across Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
• Excellent writing skills. No matter the subject, you are able to easily identify a story and bring it to life in a clear and compelling way – through talking points, slides, videos, and other mediums.
• Thought leadership. You bring big ideas - and the strategic acumen to actually make them happen. You are skilled at translating your vision into words; bringing peers and stakeholders on board.
• Creativity. You bring expertise in at least one relevant audiovisual format (video, audio, graphic design, animation), and you find energy in a brainstorming session.
• Technical savvy. You are well-versed in tying measurement to an editorial strategy, and you regularly use agentic AI to enhance your creative workflows. You’re able to learn systems easily, identify gaps, and problem solve accordingly. Experience using Workvivo, Slack and G-Suite apps is a plus.
• Collaborative mindset. You enjoy leading large, cross-functional projects and tackling ambiguity with your strong organization skills. You’re an active participant in company culture and good at networking to build bridges across the business.
• Tons of motivation. You are a self-starter; always picking up new skills and happy to operate in the weeds.
• Industry knowledge. You regularly follow media trends and apply them to your work to engage employees of all backgrounds.
• English fluency. Additional languages are a plus. Meet the team: This role sits within Internal Communications – a team focused on driving connection and clarity across our global team at On. We’re big thinkers and change-makers, constantly looking for new ways to inform and inspire. If you’re passionate about impacting culture and applying your creativity in various areas of the business, you’ll be in great company.

• Partnering closely with internal creative teams and external vendors to produce premium video and multimedia content.
• Writing messages, speeches, and presentations for global audiences on key topics related to our strategy and culture.
• Driving innovation strategy for company-wide channels; scoping new formats and driving them forward from proposal to adoption. Your story: In addition to a specific passion for internal communication and culture, we hope you’ll also bring:
• 10+ years of experience working in creative and multi-disciplinary roles across Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
• Excellent writing skills. No matter the subject, you are able to easily identify a story and bring it to life in a clear and compelling way – through talking points, slides, videos, and other mediums.
• Thought leadership. You bring big ideas - and the strategic acumen to actually make them happen. You are skilled at translating your vision into words; bringing peers and stakeholders on board.
• Creativity. You bring expertise in at least one relevant audiovisual format (video, audio, graphic design, animation), and you find energy in a brainstorming session.
• Technical savvy. You are well-versed in tying measurement to an editorial strategy, and you regularly use agentic AI to enhance your creative workflows. You’re able to learn systems easily, identify gaps, and problem solve accordingly. Experience using Workvivo, Slack and G-Suite apps is a plus.
• Collaborative mindset. You enjoy leading large, cross-functional projects and tackling ambiguity with your strong organization skills. You’re an active participant in company culture and good at networking to build bridges across the business.
• Tons of motivation. You are a self-starter; always picking up new skills and happy to operate in the weeds.
• Industry knowledge. You regularly follow media trends and apply them to your work to engage employees of all backgrounds.
• English fluency. Additional languages are a plus. Meet the team: This role sits within Internal Communications – a team focused on driving connection and clarity across our global team at On. We’re big thinkers and change-makers, constantly looking for new ways to inform and inspire. If you’re passionate about impacting culture and applying your creativity in various areas of the business, you’ll be in great company.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Short: Join our fast-growing global sports brand as a Senior Specialist - Real Estate Analysis for EMEA. We are accelerating our portfolio expansion of our own stores globally while also ensuring that the talented teams working in our offices have plenty of space to hire and grow together. In this role, you will ensure every decision is backed by rigorous data, every pro forma is accurate, and the transaction process moves with speed and precision. You will be instrumental in accelerating our portfolio expansion while optimizing our existing office and retail footprint. Your Mission: Market Research & Strategic Analysis
• Create comprehensive real estate analyses to advise the team on retail site selection. This includes generating reports on population growth, purchasing power, tourist traffic, footfall density, and competitor mapping.
• Go beyond the numbers by analyzing "soft metrics" such as the density of running/fitness communities, proximity to wholesale partners, and brand adjacencies to ensure locations match Ons values.
• Collect, synthesize, and analyze data from internal partners (E-commerce heatmaps, Sales performance, Marketing activations) and external broker partners to create benchmarks that ensure all real estate decisions are data-driven. Financial Modeling & Deal Feasibility
• Build and maintain detailed real estate financial models in cooperation with Finance, Construction, and Operations.
• Run scenario planning to stress-test financial assumptions before management approval. Transaction Management
• Draft Letters of Intent for new sites, ensuring all requests from Design and Construction are incorporated.
• Track the negotiation of terms across multiple concurrent sites. You will monitor milestones, flag delays, and make recommendations for counter-proposals.
• Support the legal process by acting as the project manager for lease negotiations—gathering inputs from internal stakeholders (Tax, Insurance, Construction, FM) and ensuring external counsel has the necessary commercial terms to proceed. Portfolio Operations & Workplace
• Track office utilization in close collaboration with Finance, Talent, and Workplace teams. You will analyze attendance data to forecast future capacity requirements.
• Manage the critical path for the existing portfolio, tracking key milestone dates (break options, renewals, indexation).
• Support ad-hoc lease administration tasks, including onboarding suppliers to the internal payment system, processing invoices, and resolving rent payment issues to maintain positive landlord relationships. Your Story:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or Real Estate, preferably with international experience.
• Minimum 4+ years of professional experience in an real estate analytical role (e.g. finance, real estate, strategy), preferably across multiple countries within EMEA.
• Minimum 2+ years of professional experience in an real estate retail analytical role.
• Ability to analyze data efficiently, identify trends, and comfortably form insights.
• You are comfortable with P&L structures, cash flow modeling, and understanding the financial implications of lease terms.
• Organizational wizard skilled in staying ahead of deadlines, not missing key milestones, and tracking all upcoming deliverables.
• Highly motivated, responsible, capable of working in a self-driven, entrepreneurial environment both within a team and individually.
• Passionate problem solver who enjoys coming up with creative solutions in a fast-paced agile environment.
• Experience working within Google Workplace/Microsoft Office (other data analysis software, like Looker, a bonus).
• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.
• Fluent in English - other languages are a plus. Your Team: Joining the Real Estate Development team at On means embracing a different approach. We do not simply adhere to traditional Real Estate practices; instead, we strive to build, grow, enable, and empower our teams to drive On's future. As part of Operations, Real Estate is regarded as a strategic navigator to all global spaces for On, helping to design, develop, build, and lead facilities for our retail spaces, retail partner spaces, office spaces, and beyond. Our team is growing. Come along for the journey. On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it: In short On is looking for a Senior Lead - Integrated Planning Platform to join our engineering team at our HQ in Zurich. We are seeking a leader who seamlessly combines deep, strategic Supply Chain Planning expertise with a strong software engineering / technical background. In this role, you will lead complex projects and a high-performing team that delivers large-scale planning system solutions—the digital backbone of our global supply chain. These systems impact several teams across functions and regions, ensuring On's products reach our customers efficiently. In our high-velocity culture, you will leverage your profound understanding of S&OP processes, demand and supply forecasting to scale a robust, world-class integrated planning environment. You will harness diverse perspectives from both business and tech stakeholders, anticipate bottlenecks, and confidently balance necessary technical and strategic trade-offs. Your Mission - Lead & Empower Teams : Lead, inspire, and grow engineering teams focused on the Integrated Planning Platform. Ensure the team has a clear mission aligned with On's global supply chain goals, encourage a collaborative environment, and balance managing the team closely with giving them the freedom to act with increasing autonomy. - Supply Chain & Platform Delivery : Be fully accountable for the delivery, timeline, quality, and hiring for your teams. Take on accountability for larger, more complex deliverables by managing risk, anticipating blockers, and addressing uncertainty. - Technical & Architectural Leadership : Be accountable for the team's technical decisions and solutions, acting as a key contributor to ensure they align with On Tech's architecture north star. You will guide the architecture to seamlessly handle complex supply chain data flows, enterprise system (e.g., ERP) integrations, and high-volume planning cycles. - Strategic Partnership : Partner tightly with E2E Planning business leaders, product managers, and project management to plan deliverables. You will translate complex supply chain business needs into scalable technical initiatives, define the scope of delivery, and ensure alignment on complex cross-team dependencies. - Operational Excellence : Ensure the reliable operation of your team's planning systems and adjacent ones in accordance with established SLOs. Prioritize the resolution of time-sensitive incidents that could impact critical planning and purchasing cycles, and enable iterative rollout, testing, and release engineering practices. - Culture & Values : Act as a role model for On's tech values and principles. Foster an inclusive multi-team environment that champions a culture of seeking out feedback and delivering praise. Your story - Supply Chain Planning Experience : Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree (or 8 years with a Master’s degree). You possess a profound background in the Supply Chain Planning domain, including deep functional knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), demand planning, supply network planning, inventory management, and end-to-end supply chain visibility. - Technical Background : A strong engineering or technical background with a track record of driving impact. You have successfully built, scaled, or integrated enterprise planning architectures, ERP systems, and data-heavy applications in high-growth environments. - Bonus (Anaplan) : While your primary strength is in general technical supply chain planning, hands-on knowledge and experience with Anaplan (or similar enterprise planning platforms) is considered a strong plus. - People Leadership : Proven experience managing one or more teams of engineers/individual contributors. You have a track record of grooming high performers, actively managing team performance, and driving continuous improvement. - Navigating Complexity : Demonstrated ability to identify underlying business and technical issues, uncover root causes in complex supply chain data or processes, and deliver solutions to new problems across multiple domains. - Collaboration & Communication : Strong command of verbal and written communication. You adapt your style seamlessly for cross-functional initiatives, building strong collaborative relationships with technical peers, supply chain stakeholders, and senior leaders.

In this role, you will lead complex projects and a high-performing team that delivers large-scale planning system solutions—the digital backbone of our global supply chain. These systems impact several teams across functions and regions, ensuring On's products reach our customers efficiently. In our high-velocity culture, you will leverage your profound understanding of S&OP processes, demand and supply forecasting to scale a robust, world-class integrated planning environment. You will harness diverse perspectives from both business and tech stakeholders, anticipate bottlenecks, and confidently balance necessary technical and strategic trade-offs. Your Mission - Lead & Empower Teams : Lead, inspire, and grow engineering teams focused on the Integrated Planning Platform. Ensure the team has a clear mission aligned with On's global supply chain goals, encourage a collaborative environment, and balance managing the team closely with giving them the freedom to act with increasing autonomy. - Supply Chain & Platform Delivery : Be fully accountable for the delivery, timeline, quality, and hiring for your teams. Take on accountability for larger, more complex deliverables by managing risk, anticipating blockers, and addressing uncertainty. - Technical & Architectural Leadership : Be accountable for the team's technical decisions and solutions, acting as a key contributor to ensure they align with On Tech's architecture north star. You will guide the architecture to seamlessly handle complex supply chain data flows, enterprise system (e.g., ERP) integrations, and high-volume planning cycles. - Strategic Partnership : Partner tightly with E2E Planning business leaders, product managers, and project management to plan deliverables. You will translate complex supply chain business needs into scalable technical initiatives, define the scope of delivery, and ensure alignment on complex cross-team dependencies. - Operational Excellence : Ensure the reliable operation of your team's planning systems and adjacent ones in accordance with established SLOs. Prioritize the resolution of time-sensitive incidents that could impact critical planning and purchasing cycles, and enable iterative rollout, testing, and release engineering practices. - Culture & Values : Act as a role model for On's tech values and principles. Foster an inclusive multi-team environment that champions a culture of seeking out feedback and delivering praise. Your story - Supply Chain Planning Experience : Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree (or 8 years with a Master’s degree). You possess a profound background in the Supply Chain Planning domain, including deep functional knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), demand planning, supply network planning, inventory management, and end-to-end supply chain visibility. - Technical Background : A strong engineering or technical background with a track record of driving impact. You have successfully built, scaled, or integrated enterprise planning architectures, ERP systems, and data-heavy applications in high-growth environments. - Bonus (Anaplan) : While your primary strength is in general technical supply chain planning, hands-on knowledge and experience with Anaplan (or similar enterprise planning platforms) is considered a strong plus. - People Leadership : Proven experience managing one or more teams of engineers/individual contributors. You have a track record of grooming high performers, actively managing team performance, and driving continuous improvement. - Navigating Complexity : Demonstrated ability to identify underlying business and technical issues, uncover root causes in complex supply chain data or processes, and deliver solutions to new problems across multiple domains. - Collaboration & Communication : Strong command of verbal and written communication. You adapt your style seamlessly for cross-functional initiatives, building strong collaborative relationships with technical peers, supply chain stakeholders, and senior leaders.
